hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *'git push'*|*'gh pr create'*|*'gh pr merge'*|*'gh repo sync'*) s=scripts/check-coverage.sh; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/homework-6/scripts/check-coverage.sh"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; bash "$s" >&2 || { echo 'Coverage gate failed: push blocked until coverage meets the threshold.' >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
